Description:
Elevate your writing experience with this impressive lot of vintage pen and pencil sets from reputable brands, including Parker, Cross, Garland, Sheaffer, and Quill. This collection features both single writing instruments and sets, many attractively boxed, showcasing classic finishes such as brushed gold, chrome, and matte black. A Parker set stands out in a distinctive orange satin-lined box, while multiple Cross sets include gold-filled and chrome pieces, some explicitly marked '12 KT Gold Filled.' Each boxed set visually displays minimal to moderate wear consistent with age, making them ideal for collectors or as thoughtful executive gifts. Every item in this collection is characterized by metal construction for long-lasting use, and nearly all are presented in their original display boxes. With timeless designs and renowned craftsmanship, these pens and pencils offer both aesthetic appeal and practical reliability for daily writing or display. Please note, items are pre-owned and may show light scuffs or small marks. Write in vintage style or expand your collection with these elegant and functional writing instruments, perfect for any enthusiast or professional
